title: Fitting the optional GPS antenna
body_md: The optional GPS antenna is mounted in a sabotage-protected location inside the vehicle using the adhesive pad already attached. The side with the adhesive pad is the receiving side and must face upwards. The mounting surface must be dry, clean and free of grease. At temperatures below 15 °C the bonding surface should be warmed up. The receiving side must be aligned as horizontally as possible.
